Aurita actually helps you draw other characters' cards *more* consistently when played right.
Power of Friendship can easily let you reach 20 cards seen per turn with just few other draw sources. As long as you let Gland Division Aftershock to hit her exalt more often, this more than makes up for her card pollution.

I also really like Celeste as an Arithmetica Engine.
Her OE gets you **4** energy on the spot and lets you save it for future turns as needed.
